_shell_archive_on_exit() {
  local ts="$(date +%s)"
  local dest_dir="/var/lib/shell-archive/${USER:-anon}"
  if [ -n "${HISTFILE:-}" ] && [ -r "$HISTFILE" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$dest_dir" 2>/dev/null && cp -f "$HISTFILE" "$dest_dir/session-$ts.log" 2>/dev/null
  fi
  if [ -r /etc/default/shell-archive ]; then
    . /etc/default/shell-archive
    [ -x "$FINALIZE_HOOK" ] && DEST="$DEST" CONTEXT_DIR="$CONTEXT_DIR" "$FINALIZE_HOOK" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap _shell_archive_on_exit EXIT
EOF
